summary: Completed comprehensive testing of always-unlocked paywall, guided walkthrough (both agents), and mode switching features. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend walkthrough page functional with minor React Hooks fix applied.

fixed_issues.issue: React Hooks error - useEffect called after early return
fixed_issues.fix: Moved useEffect hook before the early return statement

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/billing/status returns active=true, status='unlocked' (always-unlocked paywall)
Backend: POST /api/actions/approve-all works without 402 error
Backend: POST /api/buy/{rid}/start works without 402 error
Backend: POST /api/demo/walkthrough/next advances through 18 deterministic steps
Backend: Walkthrough covers both 'payroll' and 'buy' phases
Backend: GET /api/demo/walkthrough/status shows payroll.covered=true and buy.stage='done' at completion
Backend: PUT /api/settings switches mode between 'demo' and 'real'
Backend: POST /api/demo/walkthrough/next returns 400 in real mode (blocked)
Backend: POST /api/demo/simulate-next returns ok=false with 'Real mode' message in real mode
Backend: All existing core flows work (forecast, plan, threads, buy, settings, activity, outbox)
Frontend: Dashboard loads with mode pill in header
Frontend: Dashboard 'See it work' CTA navigates to /walkthrough
Frontend: Walkthrough page loads with hero, progress bar, and controls
Frontend: Play, Step once, and Restart buttons present and functional
Frontend: Step once advances walkthrough and adds items to timeline feed
Frontend: Mode switch to Real displays 'Switch to Demo mode' note
Frontend: Mode switch to Real hides play controls
Frontend: Mode switch back to Demo restores play controls
Frontend: No paywall UI blocking on dashboard, plan, threads, or buy pages
Frontend: Demo controls visible in Demo mode

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (19/20 tests passed, 1 test blocked by dashboard tour overlay - not a bug)

notes: PAYWALL_ENABLED=false is intentional - 7 Stripe paywall pytest tests are skipped by design
All counterparty/supplier replies are deterministic/synthetic (not actual API calls)
Outbox emails are simulated (not actually sent)
Demo reset and mode set to 'demo' after testing (cleanup completed)
